subject: general
question:
Select the option that is closest in meaning to the underlined idiom/phrase in the given sentence.

My mother said, “Think carefully about your life’s goal and then don’t __give up__ till you achieve it.”
solution:
The correct answer is **" stop doing it"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Giving up** means to stop trying to do something or to accept that you cannot do something.
 
• **Example -** *Never give up on your dreams.*​

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information**

 
• **To postpone - **To extend or to delay further.
 
• **​Example -** *Our exams have been postponed due to COVID-19.*
 
• **Accept it - **To agree or to say yes to something*.*
 
 
• ​**Example -*** She accepted her job letter from amazon.*
 
 
 
• *Examine it - *To inspect something carefully*.*
 
 
• ​**Example -** *Shoaib examined the crime site.*
